status: FINAL 1s. Same TCP-only + duration-filtered protocol as the 3s/5s/8s final packages. Its split is NEW and is not paired with theirs.
filter_order: 7. packets from the first second only (elapsed <= D, before slotting)
short_flows: NOT admitted; terminal zero-padding is NOT used
empty_slots: empty slots inside a retained flow occur naturally and are all-zero

VPN.statement: Every VNAT VPN flow is OpenVPN over UDP, so TCP-only removes all of them. This package contains ZERO VPN flows; it is false to say VPN and non-VPN are both represented here.

split_stratified_on: traffic class only (never VPN status, never application identity)
split_derivation: NEW split, generated and frozen for 1s. It is NOT paired with the per-duration splits of the existing final packages. How the existing final packages got their splits: each of the 3s/5s/8s final packages INHERITED the older, separate, approved per-duration split and took its TCP-only subset -- 3s original 14e12d20312d5fd3 -> TCP subset cac127f87b766f86; 5s original 6097f7c130448391 -> TCP subset 7aa2fe07e2ffeadb; 8s original 68727548861bb3d8 -> TCP subset 278befae3cd3e10e. They did NOT use a single pre-duration master split. Why 1s needs a new split: no approved 1s split has ever existed, and flows whose duration falls between 1s and 3s belong to none of the surviving per-duration splits, so no existing membership can be inherited or subset for 1s.
aggregation: none (flow-level metrics; no UTMobile capture aggregation)
class_weight_formula: w_c = n_train / (4 * train_count_c), TRAIN LABELS ONLY
grad_clip_rationale: VNAT-specific. Pre-clip gradient norms exceed 1.0 on 92.5-100% of steps for 10 of 12 diagnostic cells; a paired ON/OFF pilot gave clipping the higher validation macro-F1 in 6 of 6 pairs (mean +2.10) and halved the seed spread at 250ms.

early_stopping.gate: counter starts only once the LR has reached min_lr

standardization: per-feature over axis (0,1), fitted on TRAIN rows only
self_contained: no symlinks; no executable, import or runtime reference to any superseded package, pilot or report directory
supersedes_note: Not a superseding package; a new 1s duration horizon.

window_exclusion_1s.reason: At a 1-second horizon these windows give sequence lengths T = 11, 7, 6 and 5. Autoformer's AutoCorrelation selects top_k = int(c*log(L)) lags and the index goes out of range for every one of them (RuntimeError: selected index k out of range). TimesNet additionally fails at T = 5 (250ms), where FFT period detection computes period = seq_len // top_list with a zero entry, producing period = 0 and an invalid reshape. Both are intrinsic architectural limits at short sequence lengths.
window_exclusion_1s.policy: Only windows on which ALL SIX models run are shipped. No architecture, hyperparameter, feature array, population or split was changed; no sequence was padded to satisfy a model; no unsupported cell is run.
window_exclusion_1s.verified_by: per-model forward-pass probe across all nine windows, both packages
window_exclusion_1s.grid: 6 models x 2 feature configs x 5 windows x 3 seeds = 180 unique runs
